footnotes: From pre-tax income to net income to Dole: includes $30.7M from equity method earnings; after $46.0M of discontinued operations, $30.7M attributable to noncontrolling interests.

Figures are from the company's Form 10-K for fiscal years ended Dec 31, 2025 and a year earlier, as filed with the SEC (income statement lines as the filing presents them); free cash flow = operating cash flow − capital expenditures. Never estimated: items the filing does not report are left out.
Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding.

summary: Revenue rose 8.2% to $9.2B in 2025. Gross margin was 7.8%, versus 8.5% a year earlier, and operating income fell 20.5% to $223M, a 2.4% margin.
Net income fell 59.1% to $51.3M, or $0.53 per share. Operating cash flow was $123M and free cash flow $1.7M, versus $180M; Dole returned $31.6M through dividends.
sources: Dole plc Form 10-K for FY2025 (SEC EDGAR)
